api_changes.affected_hosts: deterministic GANTrainer with zero additive input/output noise; frozen two-pole component host explicitly BLOCKED
api_changes.migration: default False preserves old paths/recipes; stateless check, exact consumed-jitter replay, no new RNG; base optimizer state advances once regardless of accepted scale

changed_factors: Enable finite Armijo backtracking of the actual joint G/prior DualNorm proposal on the unchanged same-batch composite objective; replay consumed rows/jitter, eight fixed trials, c=1e-4; preserve optimizer clocks/state and all local-v2 settings
mechanism_rationale: Negative parameter directional derivatives need not predict finite nonlinear proposal loss. Test actual rounded proposals and seven halvings against the same frozen-critic composite objective. This guarantees only measured same-batch nonincrease, not held-out covariance or stability.
